arxiv-1801-05665.title: Nondestructive in-line sub-picomolar detection of magnetic nanoparticles in flowing complex fluids
arxiv-1801-05665.creator: Lykourgos Bougas, Lukas D. Langenegger, Carlos A. Mora, Martin Zeltner, Wendelin J. Stark, Arne Wickenbrock, John W. Blanchard, Dmitry Budker
arxiv-1801-05665.description: Abstract Over the last decades, the use of magnetic nanoparticles in research and commercial applications has increased dramatically. However, direct detection of trace quantities remains a challenge in terms of equipment cost, operating conditions and data acquisition times, especially in flowing conditions within complex media.

arxiv-2210-13201.title: Fractional Dynamics and Modulational Instability in Long-Range Heisenberg Chains
arxiv-2210-13201.creator: Mbetkwe Youwa Laetitia, Jean Pierre Nguenang, Paul André Paglan, Thierry Dauxois, Andrea Trombettoni, Stefano Ruffo
arxiv-2210-13201.description: Abstract We study the effective dynamics of ferromagnetic spin chains in presence of long-range interactions. We consider the Heisenberg Hamiltonian in one dimension for which the spins are coupled through power-law long-range exchange interactions with exponent α \alpha . We add to the Hamiltonian an anisotropy in the z z -direction.

arxiv-2503-16533.title: From Patient Consultations to Graphs: Leveraging LLMs for Patient Journey Knowledge Graph Construction
arxiv-2503-16533.creator: Hassan S. Al Khatib 1 , Sudip Mittal 1 , Shahram Rahimi 2 , Nina Marhamati 3 , Sean Bozorgzad 3
arxiv-2503-16533.description: Abstract The transition towards patient-centric healthcare necessitates a comprehensive understanding of patient journeys, which encompass all healthcare experiences and interactions across the care spectrum. Existing healthcare data systems are often fragmented and lack a holistic representation of patient trajectories, creating challenges for coordinated care and personalized interventions.

arxiv-2510-21027.title: Customizing Open - Source LLMs for Quantitative Medication Attribute Extraction across Heterogeneous EHR Systems
arxiv-2510-21027.creator: Zhe Fei, Mehmet Yigit Turali, Shreyas Rajesh Xinyang DaiHuyen Pham Pavan Holur Yuhui Zhu Larissa Mooney Yih-Ing Hser Vwani Roychowdhury

Harmonizing medication data across Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems is a persistent barrier to monitoring medications for opioid use disorder (MOUD). In heterogeneous EHR systems, key prescription attributes are scattered across differently formatted fields and free-text notes.

europmc-pmc5645460.title: Exosomes secreted by human adipose mesenchymal stem cells promote scarless cutaneous repair by regulating extracellular matrix remodelling.

pmc-10490241.title: Progress in the Preparation of Stimulus-Responsive Cellulose Hydrogels and Their Application in Slow-Release Fertilizers
pmc-10490241.creator: Zhenghui Li, Ming Zhang
pmc-10490241.description: Agriculture is facing challenges such as water scarcity, low fertilizer utilization, food security and environmental sustainability. Therefore, the development of slow-release fertilizer (SRF) with controlled water retention and release is particularly important. Slow-release fertilizer hydrogel (SRFH) has a three-dimensional (3D) network structure combined with fertilizer processing, displaying excellent hydrophilicity, biocompatibility and controllability.

pmc-10531728.title: Image-Based Artificial Intelligence Technology for Diagnosing Middle Ear Diseases: A Systematic Review
pmc-10531728.creator: Dahye Song, Taewan Kim, Yeonjoon Lee, Jaeyoung Kim
pmc-10531728.description: Otolaryngological diagnoses, such as otitis media, are traditionally performed using endoscopy, wherein diagnostic accuracy can be subjective and vary among clinicians. The integration of objective tools, like artificial intelligence (AI), could potentially improve the diagnostic process by minimizing the influence of subjective biases and variability. We systematically reviewed the AI techniques using medical imaging in otolaryngology.

pmc-11297214.title: Efficient energy conversion mechanism and energy storage strategy for triboelectric nanogenerators
pmc-11297214.creator: Huiyuan Wu, Chuncai Shan, Shaoke Fu, Kaixian Li, Jian Wang, Shuyan Xu, Gui Li, Qionghua Zhao, Hengyu Guo, Chenguo Hu
pmc-11297214.description: Energy management strategy is the essential approach for achieving high energy utilization efficiency of triboelectric nanogenerators (TENGs) due to their ultra-high intrinsic impedance. However, the proven management efficiency in practical applications remains low, and the output regulation functionality is still lacking.

pmc-11860795.title: Symptoms of anxiety and depression among osteoporotic women
pmc-11860795.creator: A. Feki, I. Sellami, B. Trabelsi, Z. Gassara, S. Ben Djemaa, A. Abbes, M. Ezzeddine, M. H. Kallel, H. Fourati, R. Akrout, Y. Mejdoub, S. Baklouti
pmc-11860795.description: IntroductionOsteoporosis (OP) prevalence is on the rise as a result of an ageing population and lifestyle factors such as inactivity. Previous research has reported OP in individuals with depressive symptoms. Furthermore, OP has been shown to be a risk factor for anxiety.

pmc-12495709.title: Analysis of factors influencing digital literacy of rural elderly people-evidence from China
pmc-12495709.creator: Zhaoting Zhang
pmc-12495709.description: BackgroundTo analyze the factors influencing the digital Literacy of the rural elderly, this study conducted interviews with people aged 60 and above in rural towns in eastern, central, and western China. The study examines the correlation between digital literacy and influencing factors among the elderly.MethodsThe categories of digital literacy and influencing factors were first identified.

pmc-12610498.title: Multi-Metaomics Unveils the Development Process of Microbial Communities During the Fermentation of Baobaoqu
pmc-12610498.creator: Qingchun Luo, Xi Li, Jianghua Li, Yanping Lu, Jian Chen, Jian Su, Dong Zhao, Jiao Hu, Xia Zhang, Pengju Zhao, Zhu Zhang, Qingmei Zhang, Xuejun Lei, Jinhe Bai, Jia Zheng, Xinrui Zhao, Alberto Cepeda Sáez
pmc-12610498.description: In order to understand the dynamic interaction process among species, enzymes, and metabolites during the fermentation process of Baobaoqu, which is a representative Daqu starter for Chinese baijiu, the intimate connection between the progression of microbial communities and the diversities and activities of enzymes was examined by metagenomics, metatranscriptomics and metaproteomics.

pmc-12997087.title: Long non-coding RNA NKILA regulates the JAK2/STAT3 pathway to exacerbate TGF-β1-mediated renal fibrosis
pmc-12997087.creator: Yu Han, Siqi Yang, Jing Zhang, Yaoguang Wang, Xi Zhao, Huan Liu
pmc-12997087.description: Renal interstitial fibrosis is a common pathological outcome of acute and chronic kidney disease. Within the present study, the aim was to explore whether long non-coding RNA (lncRNA) NKILA regulates TGF-β1-induced renal tubular epithelial fibrosis through the JAK-2/STAT3 pathway and its underlying mechanisms. A renal fibrosis model was established by treating HK-2 cells with TGF-β1.

pmc-13273117.title: Adding induction intrathecal cytarabine in newly diagnosed CNS2 B-acute lymphoblastic leukemia does not improve outcomes∗
pmc-13273117.creator: Cathy A. Lee-Miller, John A. Kairalla, Emily Hibbitts, Naomi J. Winick, Karen R. Rabin, Anne Angiolillo, Reuven J. Schore, Wanda L. Salzer, Michael J. Burke, Mignon L. Loh, Elizabeth A. Raetz, Stephen P. Hunger, Meenakshi Devidas, David T. Teachey, Sumit Gupta, Jennifer L. McNeer
pmc-13273117.description: Key Points•The addition of intrathecal cytarabine in induction does not mitigate the adverse prognostic impact of CNS2 status in children with B-ALL.•Worse outcomes for patients with CNS2 B-ALL are largely due to increased risk for isolated CNS relapses; new strategies must be sought.

pmc-13338652.title: Discrimination, Social Support, and Identity Development in Relation to Career Agency Among LGB Emerging Adults: A Latent Profile Analysis
pmc-13338652.creator: Jeongeun Park
pmc-13338652.description: IntroductionEmerging adulthood is a critical developmental period for identity consolidation and career preparation, yet lesbian, gay, and bisexual (LGB) emerging adults often face intersecting challenges during this stage. Using a person‐centered approach, this study explored heterogeneity in developmental experiences among LGB emerging adults and examined how these experiences relate to career agency, conceptualized as work volition.

pmc-13346114.title: An electroactive platform enabled by near-field communication for accelerating infected diabetic wound healing via directional electric field reshaping and immunomodulation
pmc-13346114.creator: Yuange Zong, Ying Chen, Kexin Deng, Peng Zheng, Hongling Zhou, Ze Zhang, Wanqi Huang, Danyang Huang, Yuan Peng, Jiaping Zhang
pmc-13346114.description: Electrical stimulation for diabetic wound healing predominantly relies on wired power supplies, which not only increase the risk of secondary infection and complicate clinical operation but may also misalign with the endogenous bioelectric field (EF), collectively limiting effective tissue repair.
